protocol_notes.ecmp_tiebreak: When multiple equal-cost next-hops exist for a destination, select the next-hop with the lowest loopback IP address.
protocol_notes.implicit_null: LDP label value 3 represents implicit-null, used by a router for its own loopback FEC to signal penultimate hop popping.
protocol_notes.originator_id: A PE must discard any received VPN route whose originator_id matches the PE's own loopback address.
